Evaluator instructions

  1. Read the complete conversation.
  2. Validate each green model-union Task as Present or Not present.
  3. Validate each green model-union KC and each yellow nearby KC as Present or Not present.
  4. After choosing Present or Not present, you may use the 1–10 slider to rate the strength of that decision. Click the selected decision again to clear it.
  5. For a Present KC, you may also select the evidence/presence category.
  6. If another KC not shown in green/yellow is relevant, find it in the scrollable Other KCs list and add it. It will appear as a white decision card.
  7. Green/yellow colors are search aids only. They do not mean the item is correct.
  8. You do not have to make a decision for every listed Task or KC. Mark only the items you are comfortable evaluating, and you may mark the case reviewed at any time.
  9. When all cases are complete, download the CSV report and return it to the researcher.
